_readme: Explicit anchor SKUs for the HGB tracker (update.py v5). path1 = counts like an All-In-One Trainer / functional trainer (one is enough for a qualifying cart). anchor = general anchor (needs a second anchor or an attach item). exclude = never an anchor. For multi-box products list ONE marker SKU per unit (e.g. Base Box 1), never every box. Unclassified anchor-like SKUs are listed in hgb-review.json after each run.

_path1_notes.F-FTR: Force USA Functional Trainer Rack, agreed as an anchor 8 Oct 2026
_path1_notes.PRA-FT-2000-S: REP Altitude functional trainer attachment, base crate = 1 per unit
_path1_notes.PRA-FT-DUAL-5002-S: REP Ares 2.0 (5000 series) functional trainer, base + stacks = 1 per unit
_path1_notes.PRA-FT-DUAL-4002-S: REP Ares 2.0 (4000 series) functional trainer, base + stacks = 1 per unit

_anchor_notes.PR-2000-03: REP Altitude power rack, Base Box 1 = 1 per rack (rack only; with the functional trainer attachment the cart also has PRA-FT-2000-S)
_anchor_notes.leg press: Leg press / hack squat machines are general anchors (agreed with Adam, Oct 2026). Listed SKUs are the active complete machines; new ones are also caught by the LEG PRESS / HACK SQUAT description rule in update.py. G3 leg press plates/attachments (F-G3-V2-LEGPRESS, F-G3-LEGPRESS) are attachments, not anchors.

_exclude_notes.PR-2000-01-* / PR-2000-02-*: REP Altitude uprights (component; the rack is counted once via PR-2000-03)
_exclude_notes.IT7001: Impulse Ultimate Smith Machine: not an anchor (Adam, Oct 2026)
_exclude_notes.F-G3-LEGPRESS / F-G3-V2-LEGPRESS: G3 leg press plate attachments: attachments, not anchors (the G3 itself is the anchor)
